facts.fact: The article, citing a Global Finance report, says Morocco launched its digital roadmap in 2020, spearheaded by the Agency for Digital Development, naming no adopting act.

note: Digital Morocco 2030 is classed national because the article says it consolidates fintech, AI and e-government; no date, period, cost or report is given for it. The 2020 roadmap has no described scope, so its class is empty.
